\section[das Wochenende]{das Wochenende — the weekend}

\label{lesson:GE-C137-wochenende}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for to order, then the German for rather.

The weekend starts on Saturday: say \emph{Sonnabend}, the northern word for it.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: das Wochenende}
\textbf{das Wochenende} — \textquotedblleft{}the weekend\textquotedblright{}.

One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}
